user.title: Virtual AMS Setup
user.description: Connect your Bambulab printer sensors. These are provided by the ha-bambulab integration.

data_description.spool_sensor: Entity that reports the currently loaded spool (name, color, material).
data_description.print_state_sensor: Entity that reports the print phase (printing / idle).
data_description.print_weight_sensor: Entity that reports the weight of the last print in grams.
